title: Merge PcbLib files from a folder into a new library
summary: Shows how to copy footprints between PCB libraries: create a new PcbLib, clone every footprint of every .PcbLib in a folder with ReplicateWithChildren, register the copies with unique names and save the result.
phrasings: combine several footprint libraries into one
copy footprints from one PcbLib to another
clone a footprint into a different library
create a new PCB library and save it
handle duplicate footprint names when merging

commands.name: MergePcbLibs
commands.description: Merge all PcbLib files of a folder into a new PcbLib
commands.params: Folder=<folder with .PcbLib files> (menu without Folder: folder picker)|Out=<folder or .PcbLib path> (default: temp folder, file PcbLibMerge.PcbLib)|Overwrite=true (replace an existing Out file)|Duplicates=Rename|Skip (default Rename)|Reference=Center|Keep (default Center: changes every copied footprint; Keep copies them unchanged)

commands.name: ListFootprints
commands.description: List the footprints of a PcbLib file (read-back check)
